label: About
title: About Browserless Website Garden
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1211 recent saved-signal files and 321 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @nonperformant: tweet 2102499806484861027 and WEBSITES WEBSITES WEBSITES!, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Browserless Website Garden: Browserless risograph website-garden, game-space surface under overhead scan: a panoramic 5:3 white field with strong canals of empty paper. A glossy black organic path crops through the right edge as one hero source mass, balanced by a pale web-exhibition facade cluster on the left. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against upper oval void inside the black glossy ribbon, washed greenhouse facade cluster near the upper center, and small glass garden kiosk with colored panels.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
